# E-Commerce Platform Overview

## Overview
This dashboard gives CartNova Commerce a real-time operational view of order pipeline health, inventory status, shopper activity, and fulfillment performance. It supports operations managers, logistics leads, and merchandising teams in identifying bottlenecks and customer experience risks across the full e-commerce lifecycle.

## Key Metrics
- Active Orders: 3,420
- Order Fulfillment Rate: 96.8%
- Inventory Stockout Rate: 2.4%
- Return Rate: 7.1%
- Daily Active Shoppers: 8,200

## Insights
- Fulfillment rate exceeds 96% target; Southeast Asia shipments are the primary source of delay exceptions
- Stockout rate remains below the 3% threshold despite seasonal demand spike in April
- Return rate of 7.1% is within acceptable range; size-related returns represent the largest single category

widgets.title: Order Status Distribution
widgets.description: Breaks down current orders by status (Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled) to surface pipeline blockages.

widgets.title: Daily Order Volume Trend
widgets.description: Plots total orders placed per day over the past 12 months to identify seasonal demand patterns and volume anomalies.

widgets.title: Return Rate by Category
widgets.description: Shows the return rate percentage for each product category to identify quality issues, sizing problems, or listing inaccuracies.

widgets.name: Fulfillment Issue Tracker
widgets.description: Lists open order issues and shipping delays with order ID, issue type, status, and assigned team member for fast resolution.
